work.abandon.title: abandon this work
work.abandon.lead: Abandoning {{what}} gives its work up on this machine for good: it takes what goes below and keeps what stays, each with why. Each quest it declines keeps your reason.
work.abandon.nothingLeft: Nothing of {{what}} is left to abandon on this machine.
work.abandon.act.declineOpen: declined with your reason, only while it is open
work.abandon.act.declineTaken: its sessions stopped, then declined with your reason
work.abandon.act.stopReview: stopped; it stays to review, since its tree keeps work
work.abandon.act.endReview: ended unanswered; it stays to review, since its tree keeps work
work.abandon.act.delete: deleted: its tree is already gone
work.abandon.why.takenElsewhere: taken on {{machine}}: its work is theirs; decline it on its page if you mean to stop it there
work.abandon.why.takenElsewhereUnnamed: taken on another machine: its work is theirs; decline it on its page if you mean to stop it there
work.abandon.why.takenOutside: taken here outside Daoris: its work is wherever its taker works, not in a tree Daoris made
work.abandon.why.done: done: finished work keeps its record
work.abandon.why.teammate: it runs on {{machine}}; nothing this machine sends reaches it
work.abandon.why.review: still to review: its tree keeps work
work.abandon.why.reviewChanged: it changed since the list: its tree keeps work to review
work.abandon.why.landedChanged: it changed since the list: a landing took its work
work.abandon.why.elsewhere: its commits are on `{{where}}`; the tree stays for its review, the clean-up and Discard tree
work.abandon.why.elsewhereUnnamed: some of its commits are on another branch, a git remote or a tag; the tree stays for its review
work.abandon.why.checkedOut: its branch is checked out somewhere else
work.abandon.why.unknown: git could not say whether its work is anywhere else, so it stays
work.abandon.why.inUse: a session still runs in it
work.abandon.why.unreached: a session of it could not be stopped; Abandon… again asks again
work.abandon.why.gone: it is gone, or needs nothing now
work.abandon.why.joined: it joined the work after the list, so it was not taken
work.abandon.went.discarded: Discarded {{repository}} {{branch}} at {{tip}}: `git branch {{branch}} {{tip}}`, in {{repository}}, brings it back while git keeps its commits.
work.abandon.went.deleted: Deleted {{repository}} {{branch}} at {{tip}}, whose tree was gone: `git branch {{branch}} {{tip}}`, in {{repository}}, brings it back while git keeps its commits.
work.abandon.declines.confirmed: The remote confirmed the decline of #{{quest}}.
work.abandon.declines.lost: #{{quest}} was taken on another machine before your decline reached the remote; it stays theirs, and the conflict is on the quest.
work.abandon.declines.unconfirmed: The decline of #{{quest}} is unconfirmed: it travels on the next sync, where the same rule applies.
work.abandon.stillPaused: It stays paused: a step could not finish, or work joined after the list. Abandon… again, or Resume.
work.abandon.nothing: Nothing of {{what}} was left to abandon on this machine, so nothing changed.
work.abandon.done.changed: Abandoned {{what}}: {{went}} of {{count}} piece; {{changed}} changed since the list and stayed.
work.abandon.done.changed_other: Abandoned {{what}}: {{went}} of {{count}} pieces; {{changed}} changed since the list and stayed.
